## Summary

A short description of what you would like.

## Scientific motivation

Why would this feature be useful? What biological or analytical problem does it address?

## Proposed behaviour

Describe how you would expect the feature to work. If relevant, show an example config change, CLI flag, or output format.

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried any workarounds? Are there existing tools that partially address this?

## Additional context

Any other context, references, or example datasets that would help scope the request.
